title: ALL CAPS: THE HISTORY OF THE AMERICAN BASEBALL HAT
chaptersLine: Forty-plus chapters drafted, plus an introduction and a closing coda.
spanLine: From before the Civil War to the drops of 2026.
thisWeek: Four fresh manuscript passes landed on September 20 and 21, each one saved and backed up before the next went in.
A new scene opening in a room we will not name yet, and new material folded into a longer multi-part portrait.
The three rolling production ledgers moved again on September 22, keeping the market read, photo rights, and open questions current.
chapterHighlights: Beaver felt, silk top hats, and the American hat economy before the game had a cap at all.
Wild names and loud logos from the minor-league teams that out-designed the majors.
Rally caps, Griffey, and the quiet rebellion of turning the brim around.
Where vintage caps get priced, faked, and verified, one stitch at a time.
